verdict.rationale: Ramp documents AI auto-categorization of transactions based on transaction details, history, and team feedback, with coded transactions synced directly to the ERP. It names an auto-coding agent and shows invoices coded to the right GL account, and it separately documents multi-entity support with consolidated reporting. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that auto-coding applies per-entity across multiple entities (multi-entity and auto-coding are documented separately), concrete close-time acceleration metrics, and independent or hands-on corroboration of coding accuracy.
